name: com.uqual/loan-readiness
title: UQUAL Loan Readiness
description: Powered by UQUAL loan readiness tools, educational calculations and agency references.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_dti
tools.description: Computes front-end and back-end mortgage debt-to-income (DTI) ratios, student loan agency imputations (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, VA), maximum allowable monthly debt across FHA (31/43 standard, 46.99/56.99 AUS), Conventional (28/36 to 45/50 AUS), VA (41% benchmark), and USDA (29/41), plus...

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross pre-tax monthly qualifying household income in USD (for example 7500).

proposedHousingPayment.description: Optional total monthly proposed PITI + MIP/PMI + HOA housing payment in USD. Used when individual housing components are omitted.

principalAndInterest.description: Monthly mortgage principal and interest payment in USD.

propertyTaxes.description: Monthly property tax escrow amount in USD.

homeownersInsurance.description: Monthly hazard/homeowners insurance amount in USD.

hoaOrMudDues.description: Monthly HOA, condo, or MUD dues in USD.

estimatedPmiOrMip.description: Monthly private mortgage insurance (PMI) or FHA/USDA annual fee in USD.

otherMonthlyDebt.description: Optional combined non-housing monthly debt payments (excluding student loans if studentLoanBalance is provided).

creditCardMinimums.description: Total monthly minimum payments across revolving credit cards in USD.

autoLoanPayments.description: Total monthly auto loan or lease payments in USD.

personalInstallmentLoans.description: Total monthly personal or installment loan payments in USD.

alimonyChildSupportOther.description: Monthly court-ordered support or other recurring credit-report obligations in USD.

studentLoanBalance.description: Total outstanding student loan balance in USD.

reportedStudentLoanPayment.description: Monthly student loan payment shown on credit report or servicer letter in USD.

studentLoanPlanType.description: Repayment status of federal or private student loans.

selectedStudentLoanAgency.description: Agency rule used to impute or accept monthly student loan payment.

availableLumpSumCash.description: Optional liquid cash available to test lump-sum debt paydown vs reserve retention in USD.

debtBalanceToPayOff.description: Optional target debt balance to eliminate in lump-sum DTI tradeoff simulation in USD.

monthlyPaymentEliminated.description: Optional monthly payment eliminated if target debt is paid off in USD.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for deterministic front-end and back-end mortgage DTI calculation across FHA, Conventional, VA, and USDA.

tools.name: calculate_mortgage_affordability
tools.description: Computes maximum affordable home purchase price across FHA, Conventional, VA, and USDA, full PITI + MIP/PMI + HOA breakdown, required cash-to-close, and how +20/+40/+60 credit score gains or monthly debt reduction expand purchasing power.

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross pre-tax monthly household income in USD.

monthlyNonHousingDebt.description: Total recurring monthly non-housing debt payments in USD.

liquidSavings.description: Total verifiable liquid cash available for down payment, closing costs, and reserves in USD.

creditScore.description: Representative middle FICO mortgage credit score (300 to 850).

selectedProgram.description: Primary mortgage program to highlight alongside the 4-program comparison.

dtiMode.description: Underwriting DTI ceiling posture: conservative 36%, standard 43%, or automated underwriting max 50%.

customDownPaymentPct.description: Optional custom down payment percentage override (for example 5 or 10).

interestRatePct.description: Annual note interest rate percentage (for example 6.5).

loanTermYears.description: Mortgage amortization term in years (15 or 30).

propertyTaxRatePct.description: Annual property tax rate as percentage of purchase price (for example 1.25, or 2.1 for Texas).

monthlyInsurance.description: Estimated monthly homeowners insurance premium in USD.

monthlyHoa.description: Estimated monthly HOA dues in USD.

closingCostPct.description: Estimated buyer closing costs as percentage of purchase price.

sellerConcessionsDollars.description: Anticipated seller closing cost credits in USD.

reserveMonths.description: Post-closing PITI reserve months target (0, 1, 3, or 6).

inputSchema.description: Inputs for maximum home purchase price, PITI + MIP/PMI + HOA breakdown, cash-to-close, and credit/debt purchasing power expansion.

tools.name: compare_fha_vs_conventional
tools.description: Compares FHA (3.5% down at 580+, 1.75% UFMIP + annual MIP) against Conventional (3% first-time buyer / 5% standard down at 620+, credit-tiered PMI with 80%/78% LTV cancellation), returning 5-year and 10-year total cost and the exact credit score crossover point.

homePrice.description: Target home purchase price in USD (for example 375000).

isFirstTimeBuyer.description: Whether buyer qualifies for 3% down first-time/HomeReady/Home Possible Conventional vs 5% standard repeat-buyer minimum.

downPaymentMode.description: Down payment comparison mode: minimum required (3.5% FHA vs 3% FTHB / 5% repeat Conv) or matched LTV.

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly household income in USD for DTI comparison.

monthlyNonHousingDebt.description: Recurring monthly non-housing debt obligations in USD.

fhaBaseRatePct.description: Base 30-year fixed FHA note rate percentage.

convBaseRatePct.description: Par 30-year fixed Conventional note rate percentage before credit-tier LLPA delta.

monthlyInsurance.description: Monthly homeowners insurance premium in USD.

holdingHorizonYears.description: Primary holding horizon in years (5, 7, 10, or 30); 5-year and 10-year totals are always included.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for side-by-side FHA vs Conventional loan comparison, 5-year and 10-year total cost, PMI cancellation, and exact credit score crossover point.

tools.name: check_down_payment_assistance
tools.description: Evaluates eligibility and estimated assistance amounts for state HFA programs (TX TSAHC/TDHCA, FL Florida Housing/Hometown Heroes, CO CHFA, GA Georgia Dream, NC NCHFA NC Home Advantage and $15,000 NC 1st Home Advantage, plus national baseline FTHB rules).

state.description: US state code or name (deep HFA rules for TX, FL, CO, GA, NC, plus national baseline for any other state).

homePrice.description: Target home purchase price in USD (for example 360000).

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly household income in USD.

monthlyNonHousingDebt.description: Monthly recurring non-housing debt payments in USD.

liquidCashAvailable.description: Current liquid savings available for closing in USD.

buyerStatus.description: Buyer status: first_time (no homeownership in past 3 years), workforce_hero (veteran, educator, healthcare, first responder), or repeat_buyer.

secondLienStructure.description: Optional second-lien repayment structure override (defaults to the state HFA flagship structure).

inputSchema.description: Inputs for state HFA down payment assistance eligibility and award estimation (TX TSAHC/TDHCA, FL Hometown Heroes/Florida Housing, CO CHFA, GA Georgia Dream, NC NCHFA, and national baseline).

tools.name: simulate_debt_payoff_and_readiness
tools.description: Simulates Avalanche vs Snowball vs UQUAL Mortgage-Readiness DTI-First payoff, targeting installment debts near <=10 remaining payments per Fannie/Freddie/FHA exclusion rules and revolving credit cards above 30% and 10% utilization thresholds.

name.description: Display name of the debt (for example Chase Visa or Auto Loan).

type.description: Tradeline category (revolving credit_card vs installment debt).

minimumPayment.description: Required minimum monthly payment in USD.

creditLimit.description: Credit limit in USD (required for revolving utilization calculations on credit_card accounts).

remainingPaymentsMonths.description: Optional remaining monthly installment payments (inferred from balance/payment if omitted).

debts.description: List of consumer revolving and installment debts to optimize.

extraMonthlyPayment.description: Extra monthly dollar amount above minimum payments dedicated to debt paydown.

lumpSumCashAvailable.description: Optional one-time Month 1 lump sum available for rapid DTI/utilization paydown in USD.

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Optional gross monthly income in USD to calculate exact back-end DTI improvement.

proposedHousingPayment.description: Optional proposed monthly housing PITI payment in USD for back-end DTI tracking.

agencyRule.description: Underwriting rule set for <=10 remaining installment payment exclusions.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for Avalanche vs Snowball vs Mortgage-Readiness DTI-First debt payoff and utilization simulation.

tools.name: evaluate_loan_readiness_score
tools.description: Computes UQUAL's 4-Pillar Loan Readiness Score (0 to 100) across Credit Middle Score, DTI, Down Payment/Reserves, and Credit Hygiene/Seasoning with compensability cap diagnostics, multi-program alignment, and prioritized counterfactual action steps.

revolvingUtilizationPct.description: Aggregate revolving credit card utilization percentage (0 to 150).

grossMonthlyIncome.description: Gross monthly qualifying income in USD.

monthlyNonHousingDebt.description: Recurring monthly non-housing debt obligations in USD.

targetHomePrice.description: Target home purchase price in USD.

proposedHousingPayment.description: Optional proposed monthly PITI housing payment in USD (auto-calculated from targetHomePrice if omitted).

liquidAssetsUsd.description: Total verifiable liquid savings/checking/reserve assets in USD.

plannedDownPaymentPct.description: Planned down payment percentage of purchase price (for example 3.5 for FHA or 5 for Conventional).

dpaAssistanceUsd.description: Optional estimated Down Payment Assistance (DPA) in USD applied toward cash-to-close.

employmentMonths.description: Months of continuous verifiable W-2 or documented self-employed income history.

latePaymentsLast12Months.description: Count of 30+ day late credit report payments in the past 12 months.

monthsSinceMajorDerogatory.description: Months elapsed since bankruptcy discharge, foreclosure, or short sale (null if none).

hardInquiriesLast90Days.description: Non-mortgage hard credit inquiries in the last 90 days.

documentsReadyCount.description: Number of core underwriting document packets ready (0 to 4: 2yr tax returns, 2yr W-2/1099, 30d pay stubs, 2mo bank statements).

targetProgram.description: Target loan program benchmark or best_fit auto-selection.

vaEligible.description: Whether borrower has eligible military/veteran service for VA home loan review.

usdaRuralEligible.description: Whether target property area is eligible under USDA Rural Development guidelines.

inputSchema.description: Inputs for UQUAL 4-Pillar Loan Readiness Score 2.0 (0-100) across Credit Middle Score, DTI, Down Payment/Reserves, and Credit Hygiene/Seasoning.

tools.name: request_uqual_loan_readiness_review
tools.description: Opt-in lead handoff tool invoked ONLY when the user explicitly consents to share contact details for a personalized UQUAL Loan Readiness Coach review via uqual.com/api/seo-leads.

explicitUserConsent.description: MUST be true ONLY after the user explicitly asks or consents to share their contact information with a UQUAL Loan Readiness Coach.

name.description: Borrower full name (required when explicitUserConsent is true; omit when false).

email.description: Borrower email address (required when explicitUserConsent is true; omit when false).

phone.description: Borrower 10+ digit phone number for coach follow-up (required when explicitUserConsent is true; omit when false).

state.description: Optional US state where the borrower plans to purchase.

goalSummary.description: Optional short summary of purchase timeline, target home price, or primary readiness blocker.

readinessScore.description: Optional 0-100 readiness score from a prior calculation in this conversation.

readinessTier.description: Optional readiness tier label from a prior calculation.

pillarScores.description: Optional map of normalized 0-100 pillar scores.

dryRun.description: Set true for local testing or schema dry-runs so no live external request is sent to uqual.com/api/seo-leads.

inputSchema.description: Opt-in lead handoff tool to request a personalized 1-on-1 UQUAL Loan Readiness Coach review via uqual.com/api/seo-leads.

resources.name: UQUAL 4-Pillar Mortgage Readiness Overview
resources.description: Comprehensive guide to Credit Middle Score, Front-End/Back-End DTI, Down Payment/Reserves, and Credit Hygiene/Seasoning benchmarks.

resources.name: State HFA Down Payment Assistance Guide (TX, FL, CO, GA, NC)
resources.description: Authoritative state Housing Finance Agency rules, FICO overlays, DTI caps, and second-lien structures for TX, FL, CO, GA, NC, and national programs.

resources.name: FHA vs Conventional Underwriting & Crossover Guide
resources.description: Side-by-side underwriting reference comparing HUD 4000.1 FHA loans with Fannie Mae DU and Freddie Mac LPA Conventional loans.

prompts.name: mortgage-readiness-checkup
prompts.description: Runs the UQUAL Loan Readiness Score 2.0, purchasing power, and optional state down payment assistance check, then synthesizes a 4-pillar readiness plan with Powered by UQUAL citations and deep links.

prompts.name: dti-rescue-plan

arguments.name: grossMonthlyIncome

arguments.name: monthlyDebtSummary

arguments.name: extraMonthlyBudget

arguments.description: One-time lump sum cash available for paydown in USD.
